messages:
maya: Partner-ops flagged a tiny per-device rounding issue that aggregates across fleets (~0.01 units/hr/device) and shows as ~2% extra on monthly bills.
aj: Oof. Any sample event + billed line we can look at?
maya: They sent a redacted webhook example and the invoice line. Example event they shared: ```{\n  \"acct\": \"acct_PARTNER1\",\n  \"ts\": \"2026-03-15T12:01:10Z\",\n  \"usage_seconds\": 0.48,\n  \"reported_units\": 0.008\n}``` Partner says our invoice rounded that to 0.01.
suresh: Likely a precision+rounding-order bug. If we convert seconds->minutes or round per-record before summing, tiny deltas add up.
oliver: Marketplace spec expects seconds with up to 6 decimals. If partner only sends 3 decimals we lose precision. Could also be we multiply then round per-row.
aj: Quick repro plan: simulate 50k events with both interpretations (seconds with 6 decimals vs partner's 3 decimals) and compare totals. I'll run today.
suresh: Short-term mitigation: parse incoming time as integer microseconds (seconds * 1_000_000) and do all aggregation with integers, only convert/round at billing output. Avoids float accumulation.
emily: Partner is asking for credits if we overbilled. We need to quantify impact, propose a credit, and run it by billing/legal. I'll prep a comms draft once we have numbers. @billing-ops FYI.
aj: Implementation plan: parser change + unit tests today, staging deploy tomorrow, canary small partner cohort Thurs. I'll own PR and the backfill script.
maya: Also add a strict schema validation: require explicit "unit_type" or "time_unit" and reject ambiguous payloads. Ask partners to move to 6-decimal seconds.
suresh: I'll add regression tests including edgecases like 0.333333s * rate to verify integer aggregation matches expected. Also add a snapshot comparing legacy vs new totals.
partner-delta-bot: Ticket PD-10221 created: "marketplace metering precision drift - acct_PARTNER1" assigned to @aj (P2).
emily: For credits: we'll run a diff by account, threshold > 0.5% triggers manual review, >1% auto-credit up to X. Drafting policy in PD-10221.
maya: Acceptance criteria: 1) parser enforces explicit time unit, 2) internal store uses integer micro-units, 3) backfill + credit calc script landed, 4) partner schema updated and validated. Add dashboard metric: "monthly_precision_drift_by_partner".
aj: Will post PR link and canary plan in PD-10221 when ready.
maya: Thanks team. Let's close the loop with partner this week. :thumbsup:
file_meta: simulated slack thread for marketplace billing/metering integration
